examples.en: The billing module was tightly coupled to the order schema, so every schema change broke it.
examples.zh: 计费模块和订单表结构是紧耦合的，所以表结构一改它就挂。

examples.en: These two classes are so tightly coupled that you can't test one without the other.
examples.zh: 这两个类耦合得太紧了，没法脱离其中一个去单独测另一个。

situation.zh: 面试官问：那个老系统为什么这么难改？
situation.en: Everything was tightly coupled. A small change in one module would break three others.

entries.note: 介词用 to：tightly coupled to the database。名词说法是 tight coupling：We wanted to avoid tight coupling between the two modules.

examples.en: We keep the modules loosely coupled, so each team can ship without waiting on the others.
examples.zh: 我们让各个模块保持松耦合，这样每个团队都可以独立发布，不用等别人。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你理想中的模块划分是什么样的？
situation.en: I want modules that are loosely coupled, so I can change one without having to touch the rest.

entries.note: 名词说法是 loose coupling。loosely 读 /ˈluːsli/，s 是清音，不要读成 lose 的 /z/。

examples.en: We aim for high cohesion: everything related to pricing lives in one module.
examples.zh: 我们追求高内聚：和定价有关的东西都放在同一个模块里。

examples.en: That utils class has low cohesion; it's just a bag of unrelated helper functions.
examples.zh: 那个 utils 类内聚性很低，就是一堆互不相干的工具函数。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你怎么判断一个类的职责划分得好不好？
situation.en: I look for high cohesion. If the methods in a class all work on the same data, that's a good sign.

entries.note: cohesion 读 /koʊˈhiːʒn/。形容词 cohesive：a cohesive module。常和 low coupling 连着说：high cohesion, low coupling。

examples.en: For better separation of concerns, we moved the validation out of the controller into its own layer.
examples.zh: 为了更好地做到关注点分离，我们把校验逻辑从 controller 里挪出来，单独放了一层。

situation.zh: 同事在 PR 里把 SQL 查询直接写进了页面的事件处理函数。你想回复：
situation.en: Could we move the query into the repository? I'd like to keep a clear separation of concerns here.

entries.note: concern 在这里指“各自负责的事”，不是“担忧”。反面说法：mix concerns（把不同职责混在一起）。

entries.zh: （改动）一路波及到（很多地方，r 开头的动词短语）

examples.en: Because of the tight coupling, one small change rippled through half the codebase.
examples.zh: 因为耦合太紧，一个小改动就波及了半个代码库。

examples.en: If we rename this field, the change will ripple through every service that reads it.
examples.zh: 如果我们给这个字段改名，这个改动会波及每一个读它的服务。

situation.zh: 面试官问：为什么你坚持要在这两个模块之间加一层接口？
situation.en: Without it, any change to the storage format would ripple through all the callers.

entries.note: 名词说法是 ripple effect（连锁反应）：The change had a ripple effect across the system.

entries.zh: 面向接口编程（动词短语）

examples.en: We program to an interface, so the service doesn't care which payment provider is behind it.
examples.zh: 我们面向接口编程，所以服务不关心背后接的是哪家支付渠道。

examples.en: Because we program to an interface, replacing the real client with a fake in tests is trivial.
examples.zh: 因为我们是面向接口编程的，测试里把真实客户端换成假的非常容易。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你的业务代码怎么做到不依赖某一家具体的短信服务商？
situation.en: We program to an interface. The business code only sees a MessageSender, and each provider has its own implementation.

entries.note: 完整说法是 program to an interface, not an implementation。这里的 interface 是广义的“抽象”，不一定是语言里的 interface 关键字。

examples.en: We put the email provider behind an interface, which made it easy to mock in tests.
examples.zh: 我们把邮件服务商藏到了一个接口后面，这样测试里很容易 mock。

situation.zh: 同事在 PR 里到处直接调用某个云厂商的 SDK。你想建议：
situation.en: Could we put the SDK behind an interface? That way we're not tied to this vendor all over the codebase.

entries.zh: 把具体实现换掉（s 开头的短语动词）

examples.en: Because the cache sits behind an interface, we can swap out the implementation without touching the callers.
examples.zh: 因为缓存藏在接口后面，我们可以把实现换掉，而不用动调用方。

examples.en: In tests we swap out the real implementation for an in-memory one.
examples.zh: 在测试里，我们把真实的实现换成一个内存版的。

situation.zh: 面试官问：如果将来要把 Redis 换成别的缓存，改动大吗？
situation.en: Not really. The callers only know the interface, so we can swap out the implementation in one place.

entries.note: swap out A for B 表示“把 A 换成 B”；反过来说 swap in a new implementation（换上新的实现）。

examples.en: The client library hides the implementation details, so callers never deal with retries or pagination.
examples.zh: 这个客户端库隐藏了实现细节，调用方完全不用操心重试和分页。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你设计一个模块的对外接口时，最在意什么？
situation.en: I try to hide the implementation details. Callers should know what the module does, not how it does it.

entries.note: 反义动词是 expose：We don't want to expose the internals. 实现细节也可以说 internals。

entries.zh: 抽象泄漏（没藏住底层细节的抽象）

examples.en: The ORM is a leaky abstraction: you still need to understand the SQL it generates.
examples.zh: ORM 是一层会泄漏的抽象：你还是得搞懂它生成的 SQL。

examples.en: It turned out to be a leaky abstraction, because callers had to handle provider-specific error codes.
examples.zh: 结果这是个抽象泄漏，因为调用方还得处理各家服务商特有的错误码。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们封装了一层统一的存储接口，用下来有什么问题？
situation.en: It was a leaky abstraction. Callers still had to know which backend they were talking to in order to tune performance.

entries.note: 动词说法：The abstraction leaks.（这层抽象漏了。）

examples.en: This class parses, validates and saves the file, which goes against the single responsibility principle.
examples.zh: 这个类又解析、又校验、又保存文件，违背了单一职责原则。

examples.en: Following the single responsibility principle, we split report generation from report delivery.
examples.zh: 按照单一职责原则，我们把报表的生成和发送拆开了。

situation.zh: 面试官问：SOLID 里的 S 指什么？你怎么理解？
situation.en: It's the single responsibility principle: a class should have only one reason to change.

entries.note: 缩写 SRP。“违反某原则”说 violate / go against / break the principle。

examples.en: Thanks to the open-closed principle, adding a new discount type means adding a class, not editing one.
examples.zh: 得益于开闭原则，新增一种折扣类型只需要加一个类，而不用改已有的类。

situation.zh: 面试官问：SOLID 里的 O 指什么？
situation.en: The open-closed principle: code should be open for extension but closed for modification, so new behavior doesn't mean editing tested code.

entries.note: 完整表述：open for extension, closed for modification（对扩展开放，对修改关闭）。也写作 open/closed principle，缩写 OCP。

examples.en: A read-only list that throws on add breaks the Liskov substitution principle.
examples.zh: 一个调 add 就抛异常的只读列表，违反了里氏替换原则。

examples.en: The Liskov substitution principle says a subclass should work anywhere its parent is expected.
examples.zh: 里氏替换原则说的是：凡是用到父类的地方，换成子类也应该能正常工作。

situation.zh: 面试官问：SOLID 里的 L 指什么？举个违反它的例子。
situation.en: The Liskov substitution principle. The classic violation is a Square that extends Rectangle and breaks code that sets width and height separately.

entries.note: Liskov 读 /ˈlɪskɑːv/。口头常简称 Liskov 或 LSP。

examples.en: We applied the interface segregation principle and split the huge interface into three small ones.
examples.zh: 我们按接口隔离原则，把那个巨大的接口拆成了三个小接口。

situation.zh: 面试官问：SOLID 里的 I 指什么？
situation.en: The interface segregation principle: clients shouldn't be forced to depend on methods they don't use.

entries.note: segregation 读 /ˌseɡrɪˈɡeɪʃn/。缩写 ISP。

examples.en: Following the dependency inversion principle, the domain defines the interface and the database layer implements it.
examples.zh: 按照依赖倒置原则，接口由领域层定义，数据库层去实现它。

situation.zh: 面试官问：SOLID 里的 D 指什么？它和依赖注入是一回事吗？
situation.en: It's the dependency inversion principle: high-level code depends on abstractions, not on low-level details. Dependency injection is just one way to achieve it.

entries.note: 缩写 DIP。它是设计原则；dependency injection 是实现手段，inversion of control（控制反转）是更宽泛的概念，三者不要混为一谈。

entries.zh: 依赖抽象（而不是具体实现）

examples.en: Our use cases depend on abstractions, so they don't know whether data comes from Postgres or an API.
examples.zh: 我们的用例依赖的是抽象，所以它们不知道数据来自 Postgres 还是某个 API。

situation.zh: 面试官问：业务逻辑里怎么避免直接依赖数据库驱动？
situation.en: The business logic should depend on abstractions. It talks to a repository interface, and the concrete driver is plugged in from outside.

entries.note: 完整说法：depend on abstractions, not concretions。concrete 是“具体的”：a concrete class、a concrete implementation。

entries.zh: 不用动现有代码（就能加新功能）

examples.en: With this design, we can add a new export format without touching existing code.
examples.zh: 这样设计之后，新增一种导出格式不用动现有代码。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你把导出逻辑拆成一个个处理器类，好处是什么？
situation.en: We can support a new file type just by adding a handler, without touching existing code.

entries.note: 这是解释开闭原则最口语化的说法。更正式一点：without modifying the existing code。

entries.zh: 只有一个引起它变化的原因（单一职责的口头说法）

examples.en: A class should have only one reason to change, and this one has at least three.
examples.zh: 一个类应该只有一个引起它变化的原因，而这个类至少有三个。

situation.zh: 同事的一个类既管报表的计算，又管报表的排版。你想在评审里指出：
situation.en: This class has more than one reason to change: the calculation rules and the layout. I'd split it in two.

entries.zh: 臃肿的接口（方法太多，实现方大半用不上）

examples.en: It's a fat interface, so most implementations just throw on the methods they don't support.
examples.zh: 这是个臃肿的接口，所以大多数实现类碰到自己不支持的方法就直接抛异常。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你为什么把原来那个有二十个方法的接口拆了？
situation.en: It was a fat interface. Every implementer had to stub out methods it didn't need, so I split it by client.

entries.note: 对应接口隔离原则。反义可以说 a narrow interface 或 a focused interface。stub out 是“写个空实现应付一下”。

entries.zh: 破坏约定（子类或实现类没有遵守接口承诺的行为）

examples.en: The subclass breaks the contract of the base class by returning null where callers expect a list.
examples.zh: 这个子类破坏了基类的约定：调用方期望拿到列表的地方，它返回了 null。

situation.zh: 同事写了个子类，重写的方法会抛出父类从来不抛的异常。你想在评审里说：
situation.en: I think this breaks the contract of the base class. Callers that work with the parent type won't expect this exception.

entries.note: contract 指接口对调用方承诺的行为。反义：honor the contract（遵守约定）。

examples.en: I think we over-engineered this; a simple function would have done the job.
examples.zh: 我觉得我们这里过度设计了，一个简单的函数就够用了。

examples.en: Let's not over-engineer it. We only have two cases today.
examples.zh: 别过度设计了，我们现在只有两种情况。

situation.zh: 面试官问：讲一个你事后觉得设计得不好的例子。
situation.en: I over-engineered a config system early on. I built a plugin mechanism for use cases that never showed up.

entries.note: 名词 over-engineering；形容词 over-engineered：an over-engineered solution。

entries.zh: “你不会需要它”原则（缩写，Y 开头）

examples.en: I'd apply YAGNI here and skip the multi-tenant support until a customer actually asks for it.
examples.zh: 这里我会按“你不会需要它”原则来，多租户支持先不做，等真有客户提了再说。

situation.zh: 同事提议现在就为将来可能支持的多种数据库做一层抽象。你想委婉地反对：
situation.en: I'd say YAGNI. We only use Postgres today, so let's add the abstraction when we really need it.

entries.note: 读 /ˈjæɡni/，全称 You Aren't Gonna Need It。口头可以直接当理由用：That feels like YAGNI to me.

examples.en: To keep things DRY, I moved the shared validation into one helper.
examples.zh: 为了不重复，我把公共的校验逻辑挪进了一个辅助函数。

examples.en: DRY is about not duplicating knowledge, not about merging every piece of code that looks similar.
examples.zh: DRY 说的是同一份知识不要写两遍，而不是把所有长得像的代码都合并掉。

situation.zh: 面试官问：两段代码看起来一模一样，你一定会把它们合并吗？
situation.en: Not always. DRY is about duplicated knowledge. If the two pieces change for different reasons, I'd leave them separate.

entries.note: 当作单词 dry 来读，全称 Don't Repeat Yourself。可以当形容词用：keep the code DRY。

examples.en: That base class was a premature abstraction; we only ever had one subclass.
examples.zh: 那个基类是过早抽象，我们从头到尾只有过一个子类。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你为什么宁可先容忍一点重复代码？
situation.en: Because a premature abstraction is harder to undo than duplication. I'd rather wait until the pattern is clear.

entries.note: premature 读 /ˌpriːməˈtʃʊr/。同样构词的常见说法：premature optimization（过早优化）。

entries.zh: 三次法则（重复到第三次再抽象）

examples.en: I follow the rule of three: I only extract an abstraction once I see the same code three times.
examples.zh: 我遵循三次法则：同样的代码出现了三次，我才把它抽象出来。

situation.zh: 同事问你：这段逻辑才出现第二次，要不要现在就抽成公共方法？
situation.en: I'd wait. By the rule of three, we extract it when it shows up a third time.

examples.en: We ended up with a five-level inheritance hierarchy that nobody could reason about.
examples.zh: 我们最后搞出了一个五层的继承体系，谁也理不清。

examples.en: I'd flatten the inheritance hierarchy and use composition for the shared behavior.
examples.zh: 我会把继承层次压平，公共行为改用组合来实现。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你为什么说那套基于继承的设计很脆弱？
situation.en: The inheritance hierarchy was too deep. Changing a base class could break subclasses four levels down.

entries.note: hierarchy 读 /ˈhaɪərɑːrki/。相关说法：the fragile base class problem（脆弱基类问题）。

entries.zh: “是一个”关系（适合用继承来表达的关系）

examples.en: Inheritance only makes sense for a true is-a relationship, and a stack is not really a list.
examples.zh: 只有真正的“是一个”关系才适合用继承，而栈其实并不是一种列表。

situation.zh: 面试官问：什么时候该用继承，什么时候该用组合？
situation.en: I use inheritance only when there's a genuine is-a relationship. If it's really a has-a relationship, I go with composition.

entries.note: 对应的是 has-a relationship（“有一个”关系，用组合来表达）。

entries.zh: （对象）把工作转交给…去做（d 开头，带介词）

examples.en: Instead of inheriting from the logger, the service just delegates to it.
examples.zh: 这个服务没有去继承 logger，而是直接把工作委托给它。

examples.en: The controller delegates to a service class for all the business rules.
examples.zh: 所有业务规则，controller 都委托给一个 service 类去处理。

situation.zh: 面试官问：不用继承的话，你怎么复用另一个类的功能？
situation.en: I hold a reference to that object and delegate to it. That's composition, and it keeps the two classes independent.

entries.note: 名词 delegation（委托）。作动词时 delegate 结尾读 /ɡeɪt/。

examples.en: With small composable pieces, we can mix and match behaviors instead of creating a subclass for every combination.
examples.zh: 有了这些可组合的小部件，我们可以自由搭配各种行为，而不用为每种组合都建一个子类。

situation.zh: 面试官问：用组合代替继承，给你们带来的最大好处是什么？
situation.en: Flexibility. We can mix and match retry, caching and logging behaviors without a class explosion.

entries.note: 相关说法：class explosion（类爆炸，子类数量随组合失控）；composable（可组合的）。

examples.en: We rely on polymorphism here: each shape knows how to draw itself, so there's no type check.
examples.zh: 这里我们靠的是多态：每个图形自己知道怎么画，所以不需要判断类型。

situation.zh: 面试官问：那一大段按类型判断的 if-else，你是怎么去掉的？
situation.en: I replaced it with polymorphism. Each payment type implements the same interface and handles its own logic.

entries.note: 形容词 polymorphic：a polymorphic call。

examples.en: We added a factory method that picks the right parser based on the file extension.
examples.zh: 我们加了一个工厂方法，根据文件扩展名选出合适的解析器。

examples.en: A static factory method can have a meaningful name, which a constructor can't.
examples.zh: 静态工厂方法可以起一个有意义的名字，构造函数做不到这一点。

situation.zh: 面试官问：调用方怎么拿到合适的解析器对象？直接 new 吗？
situation.en: No, they call a factory method. It decides which concrete class to create, so callers only depend on the interface.

entries.note: 口头上 factory 常泛指“负责创建对象的东西”。GoF 里 Factory Method 和 Abstract Factory（抽象工厂）是两个不同的模式。

examples.en: The factory encapsulates the creation logic, so callers don't need to know which class they get.
examples.zh: 工厂封装了创建逻辑，所以调用方不需要知道拿到的是哪个类。

situation.zh: 面试官问：这里为什么要引入一个工厂，而不是让调用方自己构造对象？
situation.en: To encapsulate the creation logic. Building the client involves config and credentials, and I didn't want that repeated everywhere.

entries.note: encapsulate 读 /ɪnˈkæpsəleɪt/，名词 encapsulation（封装）。另一个常用说法：encapsulate what varies（把会变的部分封装起来）。

examples.en: The request object has a dozen optional fields, so we used the builder pattern.
examples.zh: 这个请求对象有十几个可选字段，所以我们用了建造者模式。

examples.en: With the builder pattern, the object is validated once in build() and stays immutable afterwards.
examples.zh: 用了建造者模式，对象在 build() 里统一校验一次，之后就不可变了。

situation.zh: 面试官问：一个对象有十几个可选参数，构造函数怎么设计？
situation.en: I'd use the builder pattern. It avoids a constructor with ten parameters and makes the call site readable.

entries.note: 它要解决的问题叫 telescoping constructors（重叠构造函数：一堆参数个数不同的构造函数）。

examples.en: The config loader is a singleton, so every module sees the same settings.
examples.zh: 配置加载器是单例，所以每个模块看到的都是同一份配置。

examples.en: We avoid singletons where we can, because hidden global state makes tests depend on each other.
examples.zh: 我们能不用单例就不用，因为隐藏的全局状态会让测试之间互相影响。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你对“全局只有一个实例”这种模式怎么看？有什么坑？
situation.en: A singleton is fine for something truly shared, like a connection pool. But it's basically global state, so it makes unit testing harder.

entries.note: 可以说 the singleton pattern，也可以直接把对象叫 a singleton。Spring 的 bean 默认就是 singleton scope。

examples.en: The query builder supports method chaining, so a whole query reads like one sentence.
examples.zh: 这个查询构建器支持链式调用，一整条查询读起来像一句话。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你设计的这个构建器 API，调用起来是什么样的？
situation.en: It uses method chaining. Each setter returns the builder itself, so you can configure everything in one expression.

entries.note: 用链式调用设计出来的 API 叫 fluent interface 或 fluent API。动词说法：chain the calls together。

examples.en: We used the adapter pattern to make the legacy billing client fit our new payment interface.
examples.zh: 我们用适配器模式，让老的计费客户端能对上新的支付接口。

situation.zh: 面试官问：老模块的接口和新系统期望的不一样，又不能改老模块，怎么办？
situation.en: I'd use the adapter pattern: write a small class that implements the new interface and translates each call to the old one.

entries.note: adapter 的重点是“转换接口”，不增加新功能，这是它和 decorator、proxy 的区别。

examples.en: We added caching with the decorator pattern, so the original repository class stayed untouched.
examples.zh: 我们用装饰器模式加上了缓存，原来的 repository 类一行没动。

situation.zh: 面试官问：想给一个已有的类加上日志和重试，但不想改它，也不想用继承，怎么做？
situation.en: I'd use the decorator pattern. Each decorator wraps the original object, implements the same interface and adds one behavior.

entries.note: decorator 和被包装的对象实现同一个接口，所以可以一层套一层。Python 的 @decorator 语法思路相近，但不是同一个东西。
collocations: add behavior without modifying the class

examples.en: We used the proxy pattern to load the large image only when it's first accessed.
examples.zh: 我们用代理模式，让大图只在第一次被访问时才加载。

situation.zh: 面试官问：有一种模式和装饰器在结构上几乎一样，都是包一层、实现同一个接口。它们的区别在哪？
situation.en: It's about intent. The proxy pattern controls access to the object, like lazy loading or permission checks, while a decorator adds behavior.

entries.note: 常见种类：virtual proxy（延迟加载）、protection proxy（权限控制）、remote proxy（远程对象在本地的代表）。
collocations: stand in for the real object

entries.zh: 门面（外观模式里的那个对象，f 开头）

examples.en: We put a facade in front of the three legacy APIs, so clients only call one simple interface.
examples.zh: 我们在三个老 API 前面放了一个门面，客户端只需要调一个简单的接口。

situation.zh: 面试官问：下单要依次调库存、支付、物流三个子系统，调用方每次都要自己写一遍吗？
situation.en: No, I'd add a facade. It exposes one placeOrder method and coordinates the three subsystems behind it.

entries.note: 注意读音：c 读 /s/，重音在第二个音节。facade 的目的是“简化”，给一组复杂的子系统提供一个统一入口。
collocations: put a facade in front of ...

examples.en: Our HTTP client is just a thin wrapper around fetch that adds auth headers and retries.
examples.zh: 我们的 HTTP 客户端只是对 fetch 薄薄地包了一层，加上了鉴权请求头和重试。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们自己封装的那个对象存储客户端，里面做了很多事情吗？
situation.en: Not at all. It's a thin wrapper around the vendor SDK, mainly so we have one place to add logging and timeouts.

entries.note: 介词用 around：a wrapper around the SDK。动词是 wrap：wrap the SDK in our own class。

examples.en: We used the strategy pattern so each country can plug in its own tax calculation.
examples.zh: 我们用了策略模式，这样每个国家都可以接入自己的税费算法。

examples.en: With the strategy pattern, the algorithm becomes an object you can pass around and swap.
examples.zh: 用了策略模式，算法就变成了一个可以传来传去、随时替换的对象。

situation.zh: 面试官问：不同会员等级的折扣算法不一样，而且以后还会加，你怎么设计？
situation.en: I'd use the strategy pattern: one interface for the discount calculation and one class per membership level, chosen at checkout.

entries.note: 在函数是一等公民的语言里，直接传一个函数进去就是最轻量的 strategy。

entries.zh: 在运行时（而不是编译时）

examples.en: The strategy is chosen at runtime based on the user's region, not hard-coded.
examples.zh: 用哪个策略是在运行时根据用户所在地区决定的，不是写死的。

examples.en: Plugins are discovered and loaded at runtime, so we don't need to rebuild the app.
examples.zh: 插件是在运行时发现并加载的，所以我们不用重新构建应用。

situation.zh: 面试官问：具体用哪种压缩算法，是写死在代码里的吗？
situation.en: No, it's picked at runtime from the config, so we can change it without redeploying.

entries.note: 对应 at compile time（在编译时）。hard-coded 是“写死的”。

examples.en: The UI uses the observer pattern: views register with the model and get notified when it changes.
examples.zh: 界面用的是观察者模式：视图向模型注册，模型一变就会收到通知。

situation.zh: 面试官问：数据模型变了之后，多个界面组件怎么同步更新，又不让模型反过来依赖界面？
situation.en: With the observer pattern. The model keeps a list of observers and notifies them on every change, without knowing what they are.

entries.note: 被观察的一方叫 subject，观察的一方叫 observer。口头更常说 listener（监听器）。

examples.en: Undo and redo are built on the command pattern: every edit is an object with execute and undo.
examples.zh: 撤销和重做是基于命令模式实现的：每次编辑都是一个带 execute 和 undo 方法的对象。

situation.zh: 面试官问：编辑器里的撤销功能，你会怎么设计？
situation.en: I'd use the command pattern. Each user action becomes a command object that knows how to undo itself, and we keep them on a stack.

entries.note: 核心是“把一次操作封装成对象”，所以操作可以排队、记录、撤销、重放。

examples.en: The base importer uses a template method: it fixes the overall steps and subclasses fill in the parsing.
examples.zh: 导入器基类用了模板方法：整体步骤由它定死，解析那一步交给子类来填。

situation.zh: 面试官问：几种报表的生成流程都一样，只有其中一两步不同，怎么复用？
situation.en: A template method works well. The base class defines the skeleton of the algorithm, and each report overrides only the steps that differ.

entries.note: 留给子类重写的步骤常叫 hook method。它靠继承实现；想用组合达到类似效果，就用 strategy。
collocations: define the skeleton of the algorithm

examples.en: We modeled the order lifecycle as a state machine, which got rid of a lot of boolean flags.
examples.zh: 我们把订单的生命周期建模成了状态机，去掉了一大堆布尔标志位。

situation.zh: 面试官问：订单有待支付、已支付、已发货、已取消这些状态，流转逻辑怎么管？
situation.en: I'd model it as a state machine with an explicit table of allowed transitions, so an order can never jump from cancelled to shipped.

entries.note: 全称 finite state machine，缩写 FSM。GoF 里对应的是 state pattern（状态模式）：每个状态一个类。
collocations: model it as a state machine

examples.en: Every state transition is validated and logged, so we can see how an order got stuck.
examples.zh: 每一次状态流转都会校验并记日志，所以我们能看出订单是怎么卡住的。

situation.zh: 面试官问：怎么防止一张已退款的订单又被标成已发货？
situation.en: Each state transition goes through one function that checks whether the move is allowed and rejects invalid ones.

entries.note: transition 也可以作动词：transition from pending to paid。

examples.en: Request validation is a chain of responsibility: each handler either rejects the request or passes it along.
examples.zh: 请求校验是一条责任链：每个处理器要么拒掉请求，要么把它往后传。

situation.zh: 面试官问：一个审批请求要依次经过组长、经理、总监，谁能批就停在谁那儿，怎么设计？
situation.en: That's a classic chain of responsibility. Each approver handles the request if it can, and otherwise passes it to the next one in the chain.

entries.note: short-circuit 指“提前终止，不再往后传”：The auth handler short-circuits the chain.
collocations: pass the request along the chain

examples.en: The pricing function was full of nested conditionals, so I replaced them with a lookup table.
examples.zh: 定价函数里全是层层嵌套的条件判断，所以我用一张查找表把它们替换掉了。

situation.zh: 同事的函数里 if 套 if 套了五层。你想在评审里建议：
situation.en: These nested conditionals are hard to follow. Could we use early returns to flatten them?

entries.note: 常见解法：early return 或 guard clause（卫语句）、lookup table（查找表）、polymorphism（多态）。
